_source: Matched to the Warm Inboxes price list (https://warminboxes.com/price.md) on 2026-10-21.

google-fresh.label: Fresh Google Workspace
google-fresh.note: Built on your own domain, then warmed by Warm Inboxes for 14 to 21 days before you send.

microsoft-fresh.label: Fresh Microsoft 365
microsoft-fresh.note: Built on your own domain, then warmed by Warm Inboxes for 14 to 21 days before you send.

azure-fresh.label: Fresh Azure tenant
azure-fresh.note: One flat price per tenant on every billing cycle, 25 to 100 inboxes on one domain. Built on your own domain, then warmed by Warm Inboxes for 14 to 21 days before you send.

domain-fresh.label: Fresh .com domain
domain-fresh.note: Bought through Warm Inboxes: $20 list, currently $12, one off. Bring your own domain and there is no domain charge.

domain-prewarmed.label: Prewarmed domain
domain-prewarmed.note: Aged 30 days, warmed 21. Included free with every inbox pack.

domain-aged.label: Aged .com domain
domain-aged.note: Sourced individually against your requirement. History checked before anything is handed over. Priced per domain.

warmup-tool.label: Warmup tool subscription
warmup-tool.note: Flat monthly subscription, the tier most teams run (unlimited-warmup plans sit around here). Tools that meter per mailbox cost more at volume and less on a handful of inboxes.

retail-list.label: Provider retail list price
retail-list.note: What a provider charges you directly per mailbox per month at list. The comparison point for the DIY column: we buy at reseller rates, so prewarmed costs about what the licence alone costs retail.

policy.refunds: No refunds. State this plainly on /refund-policy/. Hiding it is both an Ads disapproval risk and a chargeback risk.
policy.delivery: Delivered within 48 to 72 hours of payment
policy.priceMatch: If another provider quotes you less for the same thing, send us the quote and we will match it.
